subject: Re: Renewal & expansion — pricing options, blended rates, and route additions

Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: expansion volumes & next steps

Hi Samantha — thanks again for taking the time earlier. Quick recap and the asks I promised: 

Summary of what ACME is targeting
- Current renewal: 50M tokens/month (chat + embeddings) on 1.0 plan
- Expansion ask: add two new routes (batch summarization + reranking) and pilot a newer open model for low-latency inference
- Expected incremental volume: 200M tokens/month in Q2, ramping to ~1.2B tokens/month by Q4 with seasonal spikes

Pricing/qualification items we need to confirm from your side
1) Target blended unit economics: you mentioned a target in the ballpark of $700–$900 / 1M tokens — can you confirm a firm range?
2) Commitment tiers: can ACME commit to step-ups (e.g., 200M, 500M, 1B) for blended rate calculations?
3) Appetite for model variants: do you want a single blended rate across routes/models or distinct rates per route?

Immediate next steps
- Samantha: confirm target $/1M tokens range and committed tiers by EOD Wed 2/11
- Redwood (Marissa): produce two pricing options (conservative & aggressive blended) and a one-page proposal + ramp table by Thu 2/12
- Copy Rishi/Priyom for technical sizing and Monica for post-sales onboarding notes

Attachments: none yet — I will attach draft proposal in the follow-up.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lopez <samantha.lopez@acme.com>

Cc: ACME Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: expansion volumes & next steps

Marissa — thanks for the recap and for laying out the asks. A few clarifications from my side: 

1) Target blended $/1M tokens: we are aiming for something under $800 / 1M tokens if we commit to a 12-month stepped volume plan (we're budget sensitive and need predictability). If we go multi-year or larger commit, we can stretch to $650–700.

2) Commitment tiers: yes, we can reasonably commit to the following stepping schedule:
- Pilot (Q2): 200M/mo for 2 months
- Ramp (Q3): 500M/mo
- Production (Q4+): 1.2B/mo baseline

3) Routes & models: we'd prefer a single blended rate across routes (chat/embeddings/rerank/summarize) to keep procurement simple. We will want line-item visibility for accounting, but a single blended cost is preferred for the invoice.

Constraints/notes
- Security/compliance: before we onboard the new model route, we need confirmation of data handling (KV cache persistence, retention) and SOC2 evidence — can your security pack this?
- Budget window: for FY26 we have an allocated budget that covers up to $7M total spend if the blended rate is <= $800 / 1M tokens.

If you can send a proposal with the two options you mentioned (conservative/aggressive) and a stepped-ramp pricing table, I will share with Procurement this afternoon.

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Lopez
Director, Platform Engineering | ACME Corp

Can you please:

I will draft the one-page proposal once I have numbers. Target: send to Samantha Thu 2/12 morning.

Thanks — Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Lopez <samantha.lopez@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 11:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call recap: expansion volumes & next steps — pricing sketches

Marissa / team / Samantha — quick pricing sketch and assumptions. Numbers are illustrative; we can tighten once the model mix is finalized.

Assumptions
- Model mix (expected): 55% chat (64K-context cost profile), 30% embeddings (lower token cost), 10% rerank, 5% batch summarization (higher GPU perf-sensitive ops)
- Quantization/variant split: 40% quantized open model (lower cost), 60% Redwood-optimized standard model
- Target volumes per Samantha: pilot 200M, ramp 500M, steady 1.2B

Option A — Conservative (no multi-year commit)
- Rate ladder (per 1M tokens): 0–200M: $1,100; 200–500M: $950; 500M–1.2B: $850
- Blended at 1.2B (projected): ~$900 / 1M tokens
- Rationale: preserves margin if customer churns after 12 months; uses conservative discounts for quantized/open variants

Option B — Aggressive (12–24 month stepped commit)
- Rate ladder (per 1M tokens): 0–200M: $900; 200–500M: $700; 500M–1.2B: $650
- Blended at 1.2B (projected): ~$700 / 1M tokens
- Rationale: deeper discounts for committed runway, can include small usage credit for onboarding and 30% off support SLA add-on for first 6 months

Blended vs line-item: we recommend providing a single "blended invoice rate" for procurement (per Samantha preference) and an appendix that shows route-specific effective $/1M to preserve internal visibility. Example appendix line-items: rerank effective +15% vs blended; embeddings -20% vs blended.

One-offs / onboarding: recommend a $25k onboarding package (professional services + training) as a separate line item — can be waived for aggressive Option B.

Security/compliance: yes, we can deliver SOC2 in our security pack; Monica, can you confirm ETA (we'll need a packaged PDF and a small Q&A for procurement)?

If agreed, I will produce a concise ramp table and blended math for Marissa to put into the one-pager for Samantha.

— Rishi
